banner.subtitle: Warn before one user overwrites another.

sections.title: Record Concurrency Guard for Odoo
sections.tagline: Stop one user from silently overwriting another.
sections.subtitle: Choose the models and fields that matter. When someone saves a record while you are editing the same fields, you see what changed and you decide what to do.

sections.flow_alt: Pick the fields to watch, two users edit, the save compares the values, the user decides
sections.html: In Odoo the last save wins: if two people edit the same record, the second one silently erases the first one's changes. This module adds a safety net on the form view. It never blocks a save and never refuses a write on the server: it only shows the conflict and lets the user choose.

items.title: You choose what to watch
items.text: For each model, pick the fields to protect, from Settings > Technical > Concurrency. Models that are not configured are not affected at all.

items.title: Checked when you save
items.text: At save time the fields you edited are compared with the values they had when you opened the form. This also works if the live notification never reached your browser.

items.title: Only real conflicts
items.text: If another user changed a field you did not touch, nothing is shown. You are only interrupted for the fields you are actually saving.

items.title: Compare and decide
items.text: A table shows Your Updates next to the Latest Data, and who saved last. Choose Force Save, Discard My Updates or Cancel.

items.title: Live warning
items.text: While you edit, a notification tells you that another user has just changed fields you are editing, so you are not surprised at save time.

items.title: Every way of saving
items.text: The Save button, the pager, leaving the form and the automatic save are all covered. A tab in the background keeps your changes instead of overwriting anything.

items.title: Many field types
items.text: Text, numbers, dates, selections, many2one and many2many values, and binary fields are compared. Relational values are compared by record, not by order.

items.title: Several tabs, several users
items.text: The tab that saves is not warned about its own change. Other tabs, and other users, are told that the record changed.

items.title: Private by design
items.text: The live notification only says who changed which fields. It carries no field value, and a user can only listen to the records he is allowed to read.

sections.title: How it works
sections.intro: Set it up once, then it works in the background.

items.title: Configure
items.text: Open Settings > Technical > Concurrency > Model Concurrency (developer mode), create a line for a model and select the fields to watch.

items.title: Edit as usual
items.text: Users open and edit the form. If someone else saves a watched field, a notification appears.

items.title: Save and choose
items.text: On save, a conflict on a field you edited opens a dialog. Otherwise the save goes through as usual.

sections.title: Requirements & Installation
sections.intro: The module depends on the standard base, web and bus modules and needs no external Python library.
notes: The live notification uses the Odoo bus (websocket). Without it, conflicts are still detected when the user saves.

blocks.html: 1. Copy the dwo_record_concurrency folder into an add-ons path of your Odoo server.
2. Restart Odoo, activate developer mode and click Update Apps List in the Apps menu.
3. Search for Record Concurrency Guard and click Install.
Reload your browser page after installing so the new assets are loaded.
In developer mode open Settings > Technical > Concurrency > Model Concurrency and click New.
Select the model, then add the fields to watch. Only stored fields that are not read-only are offered.
Only administrators can change this configuration; every internal user can read it.
The check runs in form views. Lists edited inline, kanban cards, imports and external API writes are not interrupted.
It never blocks: a user can always choose Force Save, and the server never rejects a write because of a conflict.
Closing the browser tab with unsaved changes asks for confirmation when the record is known to have been changed by someone else.

items.text: Conflicts are now detected when you save, field by field, so a change to another field no longer interrupts you. The live notification carries no values and is limited to readable records. Configuration is cached and restricted to administrators.
First release: live stale-record detection and a comparison dialog before saving.

items.a: No. Nobody is prevented from opening or saving a record. A user is only warned and chooses what to do.

items.q: What if the other user changed a different field?
items.a: Nothing is shown. The dialog only appears for the fields you edited and that changed on the server since you opened the form.
Models without a configuration are not touched. The configuration is cached, so saving a record does not add a database query for it.

items.q: Does it change my data or my views?
items.a: No. It adds one small configuration model and changes nothing in your own models or views.

items.q: What happens if the live notification does not arrive?
items.a: The check at save time still works, because it compares the values with the server when you click Save.

sections.headline: Never lose a colleague's changes again.
sections.text: Install it, choose the fields to protect and let your team save with confidence.
